newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume rises, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume rises, prices mixed.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul Gold Exchange rose sharply on Tuesday on higher free market demand and prices were mixed amid tumbling gold prices in world markets and a weaker lira in the local currency market, dealers said.
The volume jumped to 680 kilos on fresh physical demand after plunging to 125 kilos on Monday.

Gold closed down at $369.30 an ounce, versus $371.50 on Monday. In lira terms, it rose to 1,230,000 lira per gram from Monday's 1,224,400 as the lira eased to end at 103,360 per dollar after Monday's 102,480.
Dealers said the market's bearish sentiment continued as the world prices continued to drift lower. The price of gold eased to fresh three-year lows in London.
The first session saw 510 kilos of gold change hands followed by only 170 kilos in the afternoon, 61.8 percent of the total volume in lira terms.
